concept: SQS: decoupling and buffering spikes between services
tests: Decoupling a synchronous service chain with a queue so spikes are not lost and components scale independently.
expected: SQS queue between order and fulfillment; the consumer reads at its own pace (scaling on queue depth), DLQ for poison messages. Triggers: "synchronous call to a slow service", "spikes overload it", "orders are lost", "scale independently".
why_not: Raising the HTTP timeout keeps the coupling and holds resources; one big EC2 couples scaling and failures; retries without backoff cause a retry storm.
